definition.name: Artist
definition.description: A designer whose work Art Decoris sells. Holds the portrait and story shown on artist cards.

fieldDefinitions.name: Portrait
fieldDefinitions.description: Portrait photo. The card crops to 3:4, so supply at least 800x1000.

fieldDefinitions.name: Short description
fieldDefinitions.description: One or two sentences, shown on the artist card.

fieldDefinitions.name: Story
fieldDefinitions.description: The full story, shown on the artist's own page.

fieldDefinitions.name: Works
fieldDefinitions.description: The automated collection holding this artist's products.
